messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty rule `az-routing-critical` fired for region az14 — severity P1. Symptom: sustained 5xx + connection resets from edge -> serving (avg 62% errors over last 3m). Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/PD-82931

pagerduty: PagerDuty triggered: PD-82931 — assigned to jeff (oncall). Urgent escalation policy applied. Incident priority: P1. Acknowledgement required.

jeff: acked. I'm looking. grabbing grafana + logs. @maria are you near a keyboard?

maria: on it, joining now. seeing spike in `serving-proxy` error_rate from az14 egress. also seeing TCP RSTs between lb and fabric.

ajay: jumping in — early hypothesis: network polarity in az14 causing request blackholing to backend shards. will validate with fabric metrics.

jeff: quick checks I ran: ```
# health probe
curl -s https://health.redwood/regions/az14/serving | jq '{ok: .ok, failures: .failures, ts: .ts}'
# sample tcp dump (truncated)
sudo tcpdump -nn -c 100 -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-rst) != 0' | head -n 20
```

incident-bot: Automation note: fallback policy `regional-divert-v2` eligible. Can be triggered by oncall.

sophi: customer-impact check: internal synthesis — EU customers routed through az14 seeing ~30% failed requests for text-generation endpoints (chat & completion), embeddings ~12% errors. No data exposure suspected. Recording in incident timeline.

customer-success-jane: prepping customer comms. draft: "We're investigating increased errors affecting some requests routed to a specific zone. We're diverting traffic and will follow up in 30m with ETA." Will post to status.redwood after triage confirmation.

jeff: plan: 1) enable regional divert for az14 traffic -> az2/az3, 2) temporarily disable small-canary routes that still point to az14, 3) scale inference pools in targets if needed. starting divert now.

ajay: running divert command: ```
# start divert: distribute traffic away from az14 to az2/az3
rbctl route divert --from-region az14 --to az2,az3 --weights 0.7,0.3 --reason "az14 routing failures"
```

incident-bot: `regional-divert-v2` executed by ajay. Divert started (0s). Snapshot: 68% of requests now routed off az14. Monitoring rollback if errors increase on targets.

maria: seeing immediate drop in 5xx for global frontends. az2 latency increased ~12% but within SLO. Headroom: az2 pool usage 76% -> after divert 89% (still under soft cap).

ajay: scaling dedicated pool in az2 as precaution: ```
dedicatedctl scale --pool inference-az2 --replicas 6 --reason "az14 divert headroom"
```

jeff: PD note: I escalated to infra-networking team for fabric-level investigation (pagerduty page to infra-net). tagging them in the incident timeline.

sophi: calling out customer groups: API customers with pinned-region=az14 may still see failures until they are re-routed — adding a config doc to status page advising customers to remove region pin if they want resilience.

customer-success-jane: posted status update v1 to status.redwood: "We detected increased errors in one zone (az14). Traffic is being diverted while we investigate. Some customers may see higher latency. We will post updates every 30 minutes."

jeff: quick mitigation checklist completed: divert active, canaries disabled, scale triggered, customers notified. Next: collect fabric logs for 1h window and coordinate handoff. @maria, can you run a deeper packet/route trace and paste summary?

maria: doing a route trace, summary: multiple TOR-to-aggregation links in az14 reporting transient BGP flap + partial ECMP imbalance leading to backend shard unreachable for ~7-12s bursts. Evidence: `fabric.router.flap_rate` spikes + `ecmp_path_hash` mismatch on a subset of hosts. Pasting sanitized logs snippet: ```
[summary]
- 2026-03-15T02:11:24Z flap_count=9 host=az14-agg-2
- 2026-03-15T02:11:31Z neighbor_down if=eth3
- 2026-03-15T02:11:36Z partial_ecmp_rebalance
```

ajay: confirms — opening infra-networking ticket INFRA-NET-4721 and attaching logs. Recommending fabric team look at aggregation switch firmware and recent config pushes.

jeff: escalation path: infra-networking lead @sylvia (PD escalation) notified. I will stay as incident lead for mitigation and handoff monitoring. timeline: divert in place, cs notified, infra engaged.

sophi: impact summary for postmortem: customers: region-specific 30% error spike for EU; system impact: automated reroutes prevented broader outage; cost: increased token/unit compute on az2 by ~18% while divert active.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-82931 acknowledged by jeff at 1760009999. Next auto-reminder set for +15m.

jeff: preparing handoff — i'm going offline in ~25m for a scheduled call. @maria take lead for monitoring and liaise with infra-networking. I'll remain available by DM for escalation.

maria: ack, taking lead. will post updates every 10m. setting watch: `alert watch az14-divert` and creating perf dash link.

ajay: leaving a short runbook snippet for next oncall: ```
# if 5xx drops under 3% for 20m -> bring canaries back with 5% traffic to az14
rbctl route divert --adjust --from-region az14 --to az2,az3 --weights 0.95,0.05
# if target pools exceed 95% usage -> rollback divert and open capacity plan
```

customer-success-jane: will follow up with customers in 30m with status and expected next update time. open to escalate to account teams if high-touch customers request.

jeff: closing loop: incident state -> mitigated (divert enacted) but investigation ongoing. tagging for postmortem: networking, serving-runtime, routing. handoff complete at 1760010800.

incident-bot: Incident PD-82931 status: mitigation active (divert). Handed off to maria. Postmortem requested. :white_check_mark:
